text: Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain Allah Ta'ala ki zaat hamd-o-sana ke laiq hai jis ke sunne ne tamam aawazon ko gher rakha hai, yeh shikayat karne wali khatoon aakar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se is tarah chupke chupke baatein kar rahi theen ke bawajood usi ghar mein maujood hone ke main mutlaqan na sun saki ke woh kya keh rahi hain? Allah Ta'ala ne is poshida aawaz ko bhi sun liya aur yeh aayat utri (Bukhari o Musnad waghera) aur riwayat mein Aap ka yeh farman is tarah manqool hai ke babarkat hai woh Ilah jo har oonchi neechi aawaz ko sunta hai, yeh shikayat karne wali bibi sahibah Hazrat Khoula bint-e-Sa'labah (R.A) jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir huin to is tarah sargoshiyan kar rahi theen ke koi lafz to kaan tak pahunch jata tha warna aksar baatein bawajood usi ghar mein maujood hone ke mere kanon tak nahi pahunchti theen. Apne miyan ki shikayat karte hue farmaya ke Ya Rasoolallah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) meri jawani to un ke sath kati bachche un se hue ab jabke main burhiya hogayi bachche paida karne ke qabil na rahi to mere miyan ne mujh se zihar kar liya, Ae Allah main tere samne apne is dukhre ka rona roti hoon, abhi yeh bibi sahibah ghar se bahar nahi nikli theen ke Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) yeh aayat lekar utre, un ke khawand ka naam Hazrat Aus bin Samit (R.A) tha (Ibn Abi Hatim) unhe bhi kuch junoon sa hojata tha is halat mein apni biwi sahibah se zihar kar lete phir jab achche hojate to goya kuch kaha hi na tha, yeh bibi sahibah Huzoor se fatwa poochne aur Allah ke samne apni ilteja bayan karne ko ayin jis par yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Yazid farmate hain ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) apni khilafat ke zamane mein aur logon ke sath ja rahe the ke ek aurat ne aawaz de kar thehra liya, Hazrat Umar foran thehar gaye aur un ke paas jakar tawajjoh aur adab se sar jhukaye un ki baatein sunne lage, jab woh apni farmaish ki ta'amil karachkin aur khud lot gain tab Amir-ul-Momineen (R.A) bhi wapas hamare paas aaye, ek shakhs ne kaha Amir-ul-Momineen ek burhiya ke kehne se aap ruk gaye aur itne aadmiyon ko aap ki wajah se ab tak rukna pada, aap ne farmaya afsos jaante bhi ho yeh kaun theen? Us ne kaha nahi, farmaya yeh woh aurat hain jin ki shikayat Allah Ta'ala ne satween aasman par suni yeh Hazrat Khoula bint-e-Sa'labah hain agar yeh aaj subh se sham chhor raat karditin aur mujh se kuch farmati rehtin to bhi main un ki khidmat se na talta haan namaz ke waqt namaz ada kar leta aur phir kamarbasta khidmat ke liye hazir hojata (Ibn Abi Hatim) is ki sanad munqata hai aur dusre tareeq se bhi marwi hai, ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh Khoula bint-e-Samit theen aur un ki walda ka naam Mu'azah tha jin ke bare mein aayat (Wa la tukriho fatayatikum alal-bighai in aradna tahassunal litabtaghoo aradal-hayatid-dunya) (An-Noor: 33) nazil hui thi, lekin theek baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Khoula Aus bin Samit ki biwi theen, Allah Ta'ala un se razi ho.

Khwlah aur Khwailah bint-e-Sa'labah R.A aur Masla-e-Zihar: Hazrat Khwlah bint-e-Sa'labah R.A farmati hain ke Allah ki qasam mere aur mere khawand Aus bin Samit ke bare mein is Surah Al-Mujadalah ki shuru ki chaar aayetein utri hain, main unke ghar mein thi yeh budhe aur badi umar ke the aur kuch akhlaq ke bhi ache na the, ek din baton hi baton mein maine unki kisi baat ke khilaf kaha aur unhe kuch jawab diya, jis par woh bade ghazab-nak hue aur gusse mein farmane lage tu mujh par meri maan ki peeth ki tarah hai phir ghar se chale gaye aur qaumi majlis mein kuch der baithe rahe phir wapas aaye aur mujh se khas baat-cheet karni chahi, maine kaha us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein Khwlah ki jaan hai tumhare is kehne ke baad ab yeh baat namumkin hai yahan tak ke Allah aur uske Rasool ﷺ ka faisla hamare bare mein na ho, lekin woh na mane aur zabardasti karne lage magar chunke kamzor aur zaeef the main un par ghalib aa gayi aur woh apne maqsad mein kamyab na ho sake, main apni padosan ke haan gayi aur us se kapda mang kar odh kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas pahunchi, is waqie ko bayan kiya aur bhi apni museebatein aur takleefein bayan karni shuru kar di, aap yahi farmate jate the Khwlah apne khawand ke bare mein Allah se daro woh budhe bade hain, abhi yeh baatein ho hi rahi thin ke An-Hazrat ﷺ par wahi ki kaifiyat tari hui, jab wahi utar chuki to aap ﷺ ne farmaya he Khwlah tere aur tere khawand ke bare mein Quran-e-Kareem ki aayetein nazil hui hain, phir aap ne ayat (QAD SAMI'ALLAHU Qawlal-lati tujadiluka fi zaujiha wa tashtaki ilallahi wallahu yasma'u tahawurakuma) 58. (Al-Mujadalah: 1) tak padh sunaya aur farmaya jao apne miyan se kaho ke ek ghulam azad karein, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ unke paas ghulam kahan? Woh to bahut maskeen shakhs hain, aap ﷺ ne farmaya acha to do mahine ke lagataar roze rakh lein, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ woh to badi umar ke budhe natwan kamzor hain unhe do mah ke rozon ki bhi taaqat nahi, aap ﷺ ne farmaya phir sath maskeenon ko ek wasq (taqreeban chaar man pukhta) khajoorein de dein, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ is maskeen ke paas yeh bhi nahi. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya acha aadha wasq khajoorein main apne paas se unhe de dunga maine kaha behtar aadha wasq main de dungi. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh tumne bahut acha kiya aur khoob kaam kiya, jao yeh ada kar do aur apne khawand ke sath jo tumhare chacha ke ladke hain mohabbat, pyar, khair-khwahi aur farmanbardari se guzara karo (Musnad Ahmad wa Abu Dawood). Unka naam baaz riwayaton mein Khwlah ke bajaye Khawailah bhi aaya hai aur bint-e-Sa'labah ke badle bint-e-Malik bin Sa'labah bhi aaya hai, in aqwaal mein koi aisa ikhtilaf nahi jo ek dusre ke khilaf ho, Wallahu A'lam. Is surat ki in shuru ki aayaton ka sahi shan-e-nuzool yahi hai.

Hazrat Salmah bin Sakhar R.A ka waqiah jo ab aa raha hai woh iske utarne ka baais nahi hua haan albatta jo hukm-e-zihar in aayaton mein tha unhein bhi diya gaya yaani ghulam azaad karna ya roze rakhna ya khana dena, Hazrat Salmah bin Sakhar Ansari R.A ka waqiah khud un ki zubaani yeh hai ke mujhe jamaa ki taqat auron se bohat zyada thi, Ramazan mein is khauf se ke kahin aisa na ho din mein roze ke waqt mein bach na sakun maine Ramazan bhar ke liye apni biwi se zihar karliya, aik raat jabkeh woh meri khidmat mein masroof thi badan ke kisi hisse par se kapra hat gaya phir taab kahan thi ? Us se baat-cheet kar baitha subah apni qaum ke paas akar maine kaha raat aisa waqiah ho gaya hai tum mujhe lekar Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas chalo aur aap se pucho ke is gunah ka badla kya hai ? Sab ne inkar kiya aur kaha ke hum to tere sath nahi jayenge aisa na ho ke Quran-e-Kareem mein is ki baabat koi aayat utre ya Huzoor ﷺ koi aisi baat farma dein ke hamesha ke liye hum par aar baaki reh jaye, to jaane tera kaam, tu ne aisa kyun kiya ? Hum tere sathi nahi, maine kaha acha phir main akela jata hoon. Chunacha main gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ se tamam waqiah bayan kiya, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tum ne aisa kiya ? Maine kaha ji haan Huzoor mujh se aisa ho gaya. Aap ne phir farmaya tum ne aisa kiya ? Maine phir yehi arz kiya ke Huzoor ﷺ mujh se yeh khata ho gayi, Aap ﷺ ne teesri dafa bhi yehi farmaya maine phir iqrar kiya aur kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ main maujood hoon jo saza mere liye tajwez ki jaye main use sabr se bardasht karunga Aap ﷺ hukm dijiye, Aap ne farm

Huzoor ﷺ ka hukm hai ki apne sadqe tum mujhe de do chunancha unhon ne mujhe de diye (Musnad Ahmad, Abu Dawood waghera). Bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ki yeh waqia Hazrat Aus bin Samit aur unki biwi sahiba Hazrat Khuwaila bint Thalaba ke waqie ke baad ka hai, chunancha Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka farman hai ki zihar ka pehla waqia Hazrat Aus bin Samit ka hai jo Hazrat Ubada bin Samit ke bhai the, unki biwi sahiba ka naam Khawla bint Thalaba bin Malik Razi Allahu Anha tha, is waqie se Hazrat Khawla ko dar tha ki shayad talaq ho gayi, unhon ne akar Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ki mere miyan ne mujh se zihar kar liya hai aur agar hum alag alag ho gaye to dono barbad ho jayenge, main ab is layak bhi nahi rahi ki mujhe aulad ho, hamare is talluq ko bhi zamana guzar chuka aur bhi isi tarah ki baten kehti jati thin aur roti jati thin. Ab tak zihar ka koi hukm Islam mein na tha, is par yeh aayatein shuru surat se Il-alim tak utrin. Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Aus ko bulwaya aur pucha ki kya tum ghulam azad kar sakte ho? Unhon ne qasam kha kar inkar kiya, Huzoor ﷺ ne un ke liye raqam jama ki, unhon ne us se ghulam kharid kar azad kiya aur apni biwi sahiba se rujoo kiya (Ibn Jarir). Hazrat Ibn Abbas ke alawa aur bhi bahut se buzurgon ka yeh farman hai ki yeh aayatein इन्हीं ke bare mein nazil hui hain, wallahu aalam.

Lafz-e-zihar 'zahr' se mushtaq hai, chunke ahl-e-jahiliyat apni biwi se zihar karte waqt yun kehte the ki "Anti 'alayya kazaahri ummi" yani tu mujh par aisi hai jaise meri maan ki peeth. Shariat mein hukm yeh hai ki is tarah khwah kisi uzr ka naam le, zihar ho jayega. Zihar jahiliyat ke zamane mein talaq samjha jata tha, Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat ke liye is mein kaffara muqarrar kar diya aur ise talaq shumar nahi kiya jaise ki jahiliyat ka dastoor tha. Salaf mein se aksar hazraat ne yahi farmaya hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas jahiliyat ke is dastoor ka zikr karke farmate hain ki Islam mein jab Hazrat Khuwaila wala waqia pesh aya aur dono miyan biwi pachtane lage to Hazrat Aus ne apni biwi sahiba ko Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein bheja. Yeh jab ayin to dekha ki Aap kanghi kar rahe hain, Aap ne waqia sun kar farmaya hamare paas is ka koi hukm nahi. Itne mein yeh aayatein utrin aur Aap ﷺ ne Hazrat Khawla R.A ko is ki khushkhabri di aur parh sunayen. Jab ghulam ko azad karne ka zikr kiya to uzr kiya ki hamare paas ghulam nahi, phir rozon ka zikr sun kar kaha agar har roz teen martiba pani na piyen to wajah apne burhape ke faut ho jayenge, jab khana khilane ka zikr suna to kaha chand luqmon par to sara din guzar jata hai to auron ko dena kahan? Chunancha Huzoor ﷺ ne aadha wasaq tees saa mangwa kar unhe diye aur farmaya ise sadqa kar do aur apni biwi se rujoo kar lo (Ibn Jarir). Is ki isnad qawi aur pukhta hai, lekin adayegi ghurbat se khali nahi.

Hazrat Abul Aliyah se bhi isi tarah marwi hai, farmate hain Khaula bint-e-Dalij ek Ansari ki biwi thin jo kam-nigah wale muflis aur kaj-khulq the, kisi din kisi baat par miyan-biwi mein jhagda ho gaya to Jahiliyat ki rasm ke mutabiq zihar kar liya jo un ki talaq thi. Yeh biwi sahibah Huzoor ﷺ ke paas pahunchin us waqt Aap Ayesha ke ghar mein the aur Ummat-ul-Momineen Aap ka sar dho rahi thin, jakar sara waqia bayan kiya, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya ab kya ho sakta hai, mere ilm mein to tu is par haram ho gayi yeh sun kar kahne lagin Allah meri arz tujh se hai, ab Hazrat Ayesha Aap ke sar-e-mubarak ka ek taraf ka hissa dho kar ghoom kar dusri janib ayin aur udhar ka hissa dhone lagin to Hazrat Khaula bhi ghoom kar us dusri taraf aa baithin aur apna waqia dohoraya, Aap ﷺ ne phir yahi jawab diya, Ummat-ul-Momineen ne dekha ki Aap ke chehre ka rang mutaghyir ho gaya hai to un se kaha ki dur hat kar baitho, yeh dur khask thin udhar wahi nazil honi shuru hui jab utar chuki to Aap ne farmaya woh aurat kahan hai? Ummat-ul-Momineen ne unhein awaz de kar bulaya. Aap ne farmaya jao apne khawand ko le aao, yeh daudti hui gayin aur apne shohar ko bula layin to waqayi woh aise hi the jaise unhon ne kaha tha, Aap ne Ist'ezo billahis Samie-ul-Alim Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim padh kar is surat ki yeh aayetein sunayin, aur farmaya tum ghulam azad kar sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha nahi, kaha do mahine ke lagataar ek ke peechhe ek roze rakh sakte ho? Unhon ne qasam khakar kaha ki agar do teen dafa din mein na khaon toh binai bilkul jati rahti hai, farmaya kya sath miskeeno ko khana de sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha nahi lekin agar aap meri imdad farmayein toh aur baat hai, pas Huzoor ﷺ ne un ki aianat ki aur farmaya sath miskeeno ko khilado aur Jahiliyat ki is rasm-e-talaq ko hata kar Allah Ta'ala ne ise zihar muqarrar farmaya (Ibn Abi Hatim wa Ibn Jarir). Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ؒ farmate hain Eela aur Zihar Jahiliyat ke zamane ki talaqein thin, Allah Ta'ala ne Eela mein toh char mahine ki muddat muqarrar farmayi aur Zihar mein kaffarah muqarrar farmaya. Hazrat Imam Malik ؒ ne lafz 'min kum' se istedlal kiya hai ki chunke yahan khitab momino se hai isliye is hukm mein kafir dakhil nahi, jumhoor ka mazhab is ke barkhilaf hai woh is ka jawab yeh dete hain ki yeh ba-aitibar-e-ghalbah ke keh diya gaya hai isliye ba-taur qaid ke is ka mafhoom-e-mukhalif murad nahi le sakte, lafz 'min nisa-ihim' se jumhoor ne istedlal kiya hai ki laundi se zihar nahi na woh is khitab mein dakhil hai. Phir farmata hai is kahne se ki tu mujh par meri maan ki tarah hai ya mere liye tu misl meri maan ke hai ya misl meri maan ki peeth ke hai ya aur aise hi alfaaz apni biwi ko keh dene se woh sach-much maan nahi ban jati, haqiqi maan toh wahi hai jis ke batn se yeh tawallud hua hai, yeh log apne munh se fahsh aur baatil qoul bol dete hain Allah Ta'ala darguzar karne wala aur bakhshish dene wala hai.

Usne jahiliyat ki is tangi ko tum se door kardiya, isi tarah har woh kalam jo ek dam zubeen se baghair soche samjhe aur bila qasad nikal jaye. Chunacha Abu Dawood waghera mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne suna ke ek shakhs apni biwi se keh raha hai ae meri behan to Aap ne farmaya yeh teri behan hai? Gharz yeh kehna bura laga use roka magar us se hurmat sabit nahi ki kyunke darasal is ka maqsood yeh na tha yoonhi zubeen se baghair qasad ke nikal gaya tha warna zaroor hurmat sabit hojati, kyunke sahih qaul yahi hai ke apni biwi ko jo shakhs is naam se yaad kare jo muharramat-e-abdiyyah hain maslan behan ya phuphi ya khala waghera to woh bhi hukm mein maan ke hain. Jo log zihar karein phir apne kehne se lotein is ka matlab ek to yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke zihar kiya phir mukarrar is lafz ko kaha lekin yeh theek nahi, ba-qaul Hazrat Imam Shafai matlab yeh hai ke zihar kiya phir us aurat ko rok rakha yahan tak ke itna zamana guzar gaya ke agar chahta to us mein ba-qaida talaq de sakta tha lekin talaq na di. Imam Ahmad farmate hain ke phir lote jama' ki taraf ya irada kare to yeh halal nahi ta-waqtike mazkoora kaffara ada na kare. Imam Malik farmate hain ke murad is se jama' ka irada ya phir basane ka azm ya jama' hai. Imam Abu Hanifa waghera kehte hain murad zihar ki taraf lotna hai is ki hurmat aur jahiliyat ke hukm ke uth jane ke baad pas jo shakhs ab zihar karega us par is ki biwi haram hojayegi jab tak ke yeh kaffara ada na kare, Hazrat Saeed farmate hain murad yeh hai ke jis cheez ko us ne apni jaan par haram karliya tha ab phir us kaam ko karna chahe to is ka kaffara ada kare. Hazrat Hasan Basri ka qaul hai ke mujama'at karna chahe warna aur tarah chhone ke qabl kaffara ke bhi unke nazdeek koi haraj nahi. Ibn Abbas waghera farmate hain yahan mas se murad sohbat karna hai. Zuhri farmate hain ke haath lagana pyar karna bhi kaffara ki adayegi se pehle jaiz nahi. Sunan mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ maine apni biwi se zihar kiya tha phir kaffara ada karne se pehle main is se mil liya Aap ne farmaya Allah tujh par raham kare aisa tu ne kyun kiya? Kehne laga Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ chandni raat mein is ke khalkhal ki chamak ne mujhe betaab kardiya. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya ab is se qurbat na karna jab tak ke Allah ke farman ke mutabiq kaffara ada na karde, Nasai mein yeh hadith mursalan marwi hai aur Imam Nasai ؒ mursal hone ko awla batate hain. Phir kaffara bayan ho raha hai ke ek ghulam azad kare, haan yeh qaid nahi ke momin hi ho jaise qatl ke kaffare mein ghulam ke momin hone ki qaid hai.

Imam Shafi'i toh farmate hain yeh mutlaq is muqayyad par mahmool hogi kyunke ghulam ko azad karne ki shart jaisi wahan hai aisi hi yahan bhi hai, iski daleel yeh hadis bhi hai ke ek siyah fam laundi ki babat Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha use azad kardo yeh momina hai, upar waqia guzar chuka jis se maloom hota hai ke zihar karke phir kaffara se qabil waqie hone wale ko Aap ne doosra kaffara ada karne ko nahi farmaya. Phir farmata hai is se tumhe naseehat ki jati hai yani dhamkaya ja raha hai. Allah Ta'ala tumhari maslahaton se khabardar hai aur tumhare ahwal ka alim hai. Jo ghulam ko azad karne par qadir na ho woh do mahine ke lagataar roze rakhne ke baad apni biwi se is soorat mein mil sakta hai aur agar iska bhi maqdoor na ho toh phir sath miskeenon ko khana dene ke baad, pehle hadisein guzar chukin jin se maloom hota hai ke muqaddam pehli soorat phir doosri phir teesri, jaise ke Bukhari o Muslim ki is hadis mein bhi hai jisme Aap ne Ramazan mein apni biwi se jamaa karne wale ko farmaya tha. Hum ne yeh ahkaam is liye muqarrar kiye hain ke tumhara kamil iman Allah par aur uske Rasool ﷺ par ho jaye. Yeh Allah ki muqarrar karda hadein hain iske muharramat hain khabardar is hurmat ko na todna. Jo kafir hon yani iman na layen hukm bardari na karein shariat ke ahkaam ki bezati karein un se laparwahi bartein unhein balaon se bachne wala na samjho balki un ke liye duniya aur akhirat mein dardnak azab hain.

Us se baat-cheet kar baitha subah apni qaum ke paas akar maine kaha raat aisa waqiah ho gaya hai tum mujhe lekar Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas chalo aur aap se pucho ke is gunah ka badla kya hai ? Sab ne inkar kiya aur kaha ke hum to tere sath nahi jayenge aisa na ho ke Quran-e-Kareem mein is ki baabat koi aayat utre ya Huzoor ﷺ koi aisi baat farma dein ke hamesha ke liye hum par aar baaki reh jaye, to jaane tera kaam, tu ne aisa kyun kiya ? Hum tere sathi nahi, maine kaha acha phir main akela jata hoon. Chunacha main gaya aur Huzoor ﷺ se tamam waqiah bayan kiya, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya tum ne aisa kiya ? Maine kaha ji haan Huzoor mujh se aisa ho gaya. Aap ne phir farmaya tum ne aisa kiya ? Maine phir yehi arz kiya ke Huzoor ﷺ mujh se yeh khata ho gayi, Aap ﷺ ne teesri dafa bhi yehi farmaya maine phir iqrar kiya aur kaha ke Huzoor ﷺ main maujood hoon jo saza mere liye tajwez ki jaye main use sabr se bardasht karunga Aap ﷺ hukm dijiye, Aap ne farm

Huzoor ﷺ ka hukm hai ki apne sadqe tum mujhe de do chunancha unhon ne mujhe de diye (Musnad Ahmad, Abu Dawood waghera). Bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ki yeh waqia Hazrat Aus bin Samit aur unki biwi sahiba Hazrat Khuwaila bint Thalaba ke waqie ke baad ka hai, chunancha Hazrat Ibn Abbas ka farman hai ki zihar ka pehla waqia Hazrat Aus bin Samit ka hai jo Hazrat Ubada bin Samit ke bhai the, unki biwi sahiba ka naam Khawla bint Thalaba bin Malik Razi Allahu Anha tha, is waqie se Hazrat Khawla ko dar tha ki shayad talaq ho gayi, unhon ne akar Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ki mere miyan ne mujh se zihar kar liya hai aur agar hum alag alag ho gaye to dono barbad ho jayenge, main ab is layak bhi nahi rahi ki mujhe aulad ho, hamare is talluq ko bhi zamana guzar chuka aur bhi isi tarah ki baten kehti jati thin aur roti jati thin. Ab tak zihar ka koi hukm Islam mein na tha, is par yeh aayatein shuru surat se Il-alim tak utrin. Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Aus ko bulwaya aur pucha ki kya tum ghulam azad kar sakte ho? Unhon ne qasam kha kar inkar kiya, Huzoor ﷺ ne un ke liye raqam jama ki, unhon ne us se ghulam kharid kar azad kiya aur apni biwi sahiba se rujoo kiya (Ibn Jarir). Hazrat Ibn Abbas ke alawa aur bhi bahut se buzurgon ka yeh farman hai ki yeh aayatein इन्हीं ke bare mein nazil hui hain, wallahu aalam.

Lafz-e-zihar 'zahr' se mushtaq hai, chunke ahl-e-jahiliyat apni biwi se zihar karte waqt yun kehte the ki "Anti 'alayya kazaahri ummi" yani tu mujh par aisi hai jaise meri maan ki peeth. Shariat mein hukm yeh hai ki is tarah khwah kisi uzr ka naam le, zihar ho jayega. Zihar jahiliyat ke zamane mein talaq samjha jata tha, Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat ke liye is mein kaffara muqarrar kar diya aur ise talaq shumar nahi kiya jaise ki jahiliyat ka dastoor tha. Salaf mein se aksar hazraat ne yahi farmaya hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas jahiliyat ke is dastoor ka zikr karke farmate hain ki Islam mein jab Hazrat Khuwaila wala waqia pesh aya aur dono miyan biwi pachtane lage to Hazrat Aus ne apni biwi sahiba ko Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein bheja. Yeh jab ayin to dekha ki Aap kanghi kar rahe hain, Aap ne waqia sun kar farmaya hamare paas is ka koi hukm nahi. Itne mein yeh aayatein utrin aur Aap ﷺ ne Hazrat Khawla R.A ko is ki khushkhabri di aur parh sunayen. Jab ghulam ko azad karne ka zikr kiya to uzr kiya ki hamare paas ghulam nahi, phir rozon ka zikr sun kar kaha agar har roz teen martiba pani na piyen to wajah apne burhape ke faut ho jayenge, jab khana khilane ka zikr suna to kaha chand luqmon par to sara din guzar jata hai to auron ko dena kahan? Chunancha Huzoor ﷺ ne aadha wasaq tees saa mangwa kar unhe diye aur farmaya ise sadqa kar do aur apni biwi se rujoo kar lo (Ibn Jarir). Is ki isnad qawi aur pukhta hai, lekin adayegi ghurbat se khali nahi.

Hazrat Abul Aliyah se bhi isi tarah marwi hai, farmate hain Khaula bint-e-Dalij ek Ansari ki biwi thin jo kam-nigah wale muflis aur kaj-khulq the, kisi din kisi baat par miyan-biwi mein jhagda ho gaya to Jahiliyat ki rasm ke mutabiq zihar kar liya jo un ki talaq thi. Yeh biwi sahibah Huzoor ﷺ ke paas pahunchin us waqt Aap Ayesha ke ghar mein the aur Ummat-ul-Momineen Aap ka sar dho rahi thin, jakar sara waqia bayan kiya, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya ab kya ho sakta hai, mere ilm mein to tu is par haram ho gayi yeh sun kar kahne lagin Allah meri arz tujh se hai, ab Hazrat Ayesha Aap ke sar-e-mubarak ka ek taraf ka hissa dho kar ghoom kar dusri janib ayin aur udhar ka hissa dhone lagin to Hazrat Khaula bhi ghoom kar us dusri taraf aa baithin aur apna waqia dohoraya, Aap ﷺ ne phir yahi jawab diya, Ummat-ul-Momineen ne dekha ki Aap ke chehre ka rang mutaghyir ho gaya hai to un se kaha ki dur hat kar baitho, yeh dur khask thin udhar wahi nazil honi shuru hui jab utar chuki to Aap ne farmaya woh aurat kahan hai? Ummat-ul-Momineen ne unhein awaz de kar bulaya. Aap ne farmaya jao apne khawand ko le aao, yeh daudti hui gayin aur apne shohar ko bula layin to waqayi woh aise hi the jaise unhon ne kaha tha, Aap ne Ist'ezo billahis Samie-ul-Alim Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim padh kar is surat ki yeh aayetein sunayin, aur farmaya tum ghulam azad kar sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha nahi, kaha do mahine ke lagataar ek ke peechhe ek roze rakh sakte ho? Unhon ne qasam khakar kaha ki agar do teen dafa din mein na khaon toh binai bilkul jati rahti hai, farmaya kya sath miskeeno ko khana de sakte ho? Unhon ne kaha nahi lekin agar aap meri imdad farmayein toh aur baat hai, pas Huzoor ﷺ ne un ki aianat ki aur farmaya sath miskeeno ko khilado aur Jahiliyat ki is rasm-e-talaq ko hata kar Allah Ta'ala ne ise zihar muqarrar farmaya (Ibn Abi Hatim wa Ibn Jarir). Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ؒ farmate hain Eela aur Zihar Jahiliyat ke zamane ki talaqein thin, Allah Ta'ala ne Eela mein toh char mahine ki muddat muqarrar farmayi aur Zihar mein kaffarah muqarrar farmaya. Hazrat Imam Malik ؒ ne lafz 'min kum' se istedlal kiya hai ki chunke yahan khitab momino se hai isliye is hukm mein kafir dakhil nahi, jumhoor ka mazhab is ke barkhilaf hai woh is ka jawab yeh dete hain ki yeh ba-aitibar-e-ghalbah ke keh diya gaya hai isliye ba-taur qaid ke is ka mafhoom-e-mukhalif murad nahi le sakte, lafz 'min nisa-ihim' se jumhoor ne istedlal kiya hai ki laundi se zihar nahi na woh is khitab mein dakhil hai. Phir farmata hai is kahne se ki tu mujh par meri maan ki tarah hai ya mere liye tu misl meri maan ke hai ya misl meri maan ki peeth ke hai ya aur aise hi alfaaz apni biwi ko keh dene se woh sach-much maan nahi ban jati, haqiqi maan toh wahi hai jis ke batn se yeh tawallud hua hai, yeh log apne munh se fahsh aur baatil qoul bol dete hain Allah Ta'ala darguzar karne wala aur bakhshish dene wala hai.

Usne jahiliyat ki is tangi ko tum se door kardiya, isi tarah har woh kalam jo ek dam zubeen se baghair soche samjhe aur bila qasad nikal jaye. Chunacha Abu Dawood waghera mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne suna ke ek shakhs apni biwi se keh raha hai ae meri behan to Aap ne farmaya yeh teri behan hai? Gharz yeh kehna bura laga use roka magar us se hurmat sabit nahi ki kyunke darasal is ka maqsood yeh na tha yoonhi zubeen se baghair qasad ke nikal gaya tha warna zaroor hurmat sabit hojati, kyunke sahih qaul yahi hai ke apni biwi ko jo shakhs is naam se yaad kare jo muharramat-e-abdiyyah hain maslan behan ya phuphi ya khala waghera to woh bhi hukm mein maan ke hain. Jo log zihar karein phir apne kehne se lotein is ka matlab ek to yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke zihar kiya phir mukarrar is lafz ko kaha lekin yeh theek nahi, ba-qaul Hazrat Imam Shafai matlab yeh hai ke zihar kiya phir us aurat ko rok rakha yahan tak ke itna zamana guzar gaya ke agar chahta to us mein ba-qaida talaq de sakta tha lekin talaq na di. Imam Ahmad farmate hain ke phir lote jama' ki taraf ya irada kare to yeh halal nahi ta-waqtike mazkoora kaffara ada na kare. Imam Malik farmate hain ke murad is se jama' ka irada ya phir basane ka azm ya jama' hai. Imam Abu Hanifa waghera kehte hain murad zihar ki taraf lotna hai is ki hurmat aur jahiliyat ke hukm ke uth jane ke baad pas jo shakhs ab zihar karega us par is ki biwi haram hojayegi jab tak ke yeh kaffara ada na kare, Hazrat Saeed farmate hain murad yeh hai ke jis cheez ko us ne apni jaan par haram karliya tha ab phir us kaam ko karna chahe to is ka kaffara ada kare. Hazrat Hasan Basri ka qaul hai ke mujama'at karna chahe warna aur tarah chhone ke qabl kaffara ke bhi unke nazdeek koi haraj nahi. Ibn Abbas waghera farmate hain yahan mas se murad sohbat karna hai. Zuhri farmate hain ke haath lagana pyar karna bhi kaffara ki adayegi se pehle jaiz nahi. Sunan mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ maine apni biwi se zihar kiya tha phir kaffara ada karne se pehle main is se mil liya Aap ne farmaya Allah tujh par raham kare aisa tu ne kyun kiya? Kehne laga Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ chandni raat mein is ke khalkhal ki chamak ne mujhe betaab kardiya. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya ab is se qurbat na karna jab tak ke Allah ke farman ke mutabiq kaffara ada na karde, Nasai mein yeh hadith mursalan marwi hai aur Imam Nasai ؒ mursal hone ko awla batate hain. Phir kaffara bayan ho raha hai ke ek ghulam azad kare, haan yeh qaid nahi ke momin hi ho jaise qatl ke kaffare mein ghulam ke momin hone ki qaid hai.

Imam Shafi'i toh farmate hain yeh mutlaq is muqayyad par mahmool hogi kyunke ghulam ko azad karne ki shart jaisi wahan hai aisi hi yahan bhi hai, iski daleel yeh hadis bhi hai ke ek siyah fam laundi ki babat Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha use azad kardo yeh momina hai, upar waqia guzar chuka jis se maloom hota hai ke zihar karke phir kaffara se qabil waqie hone wale ko Aap ne doosra kaffara ada karne ko nahi farmaya. Phir farmata hai is se tumhe naseehat ki jati hai yani dhamkaya ja raha hai. Allah Ta'ala tumhari maslahaton se khabardar hai aur tumhare ahwal ka alim hai. Jo ghulam ko azad karne par qadir na ho woh do mahine ke lagataar roze rakhne ke baad apni biwi se is soorat mein mil sakta hai aur agar iska bhi maqdoor na ho toh phir sath miskeenon ko khana dene ke baad, pehle hadisein guzar chukin jin se maloom hota hai ke muqaddam pehli soorat phir doosri phir teesri, jaise ke Bukhari o Muslim ki is hadis mein bhi hai jisme Aap ne Ramazan mein apni biwi se jamaa karne wale ko farmaya tha. Hum ne yeh ahkaam is liye muqarrar kiye hain ke tumhara kamil iman Allah par aur uske Rasool ﷺ par ho jaye. Yeh Allah ki muqarrar karda hadein hain iske muharramat hain khabardar is hurmat ko na todna. Jo kafir hon yani iman na layen hukm bardari na karein shariat ke ahkaam ki bezati karein un se laparwahi bartein unhein balaon se bachne wala na samjho balki un ke liye duniya aur akhirat mein dardnak azab hain.

Khwlah aur Khwailah bint-e-Sa'labah R.A aur Masla-e-Zihar: Hazrat Khwlah bint-e-Sa'labah R.A farmati hain ke Allah ki qasam mere aur mere khawand Aus bin Samit ke bare mein is Surah Al-Mujadalah ki shuru ki chaar aayetein utri hain, main unke ghar mein thi yeh budhe aur badi umar ke the aur kuch akhlaq ke bhi ache na the, ek din baton hi baton mein maine unki kisi baat ke khilaf kaha aur unhe kuch jawab diya, jis par woh bade ghazab-nak hue aur gusse mein farmane lage tu mujh par meri maan ki peeth ki tarah hai phir ghar se chale gaye aur qaumi majlis mein kuch der baithe rahe phir wapas aaye aur mujh se khas baat-cheet karni chahi, maine kaha us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein Khwlah ki jaan hai tumhare is kehne ke baad ab yeh baat namumkin hai yahan tak ke Allah aur uske Rasool ﷺ ka faisla hamare bare mein na ho, lekin woh na mane aur zabardasti karne lage magar chunke kamzor aur zaeef the main un par ghalib aa gayi aur woh apne maqsad mein kamyab na ho sake, main apni padosan ke haan gayi aur us se kapda mang kar odh kar Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas pahunchi, is waqie ko bayan kiya aur bhi apni museebatein aur takleefein bayan karni shuru kar di, aap yahi farmate jate the Khwlah apne khawand ke bare mein Allah se daro woh budhe bade hain, abhi yeh baatein ho hi rahi thin ke An-Hazrat ﷺ par wahi ki kaifiyat tari hui, jab wahi utar chuki to aap ﷺ ne farmaya he Khwlah tere aur tere khawand ke bare mein Quran-e-Kareem ki aayetein nazil hui hain, phir aap ne ayat (QAD SAMI'ALLAHU Qawlal-lati tujadiluka fi zaujiha wa tashtaki ilallahi wallahu yasma'u tahawurakuma) 58. (Al-Mujadalah: 1) tak padh sunaya aur farmaya jao apne miyan se kaho ke ek ghulam azad karein, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ unke paas ghulam kahan? Woh to bahut maskeen shakhs hain, aap ﷺ ne farmaya acha to do mahine ke lagataar roze rakh lein, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ woh to badi umar ke budhe natwan kamzor hain unhe do mah ke rozon ki bhi taaqat nahi, aap ﷺ ne farmaya phir sath maskeenon ko ek wasq (taqreeban chaar man pukhta) khajoorein de dein, maine kaha Huzoor ﷺ is maskeen ke paas yeh bhi nahi. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya acha aadha wasq khajoorein main apne paas se unhe de dunga maine kaha behtar aadha wasq main de dungi. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh tumne bahut acha kiya aur khoob kaam kiya, jao yeh ada kar do aur apne khawand ke sath jo tumhare chacha ke ladke hain mohabbat, pyar, khair-khwahi aur farmanbardari se guzara karo (Musnad Ahmad wa Abu Dawood). Unka naam baaz riwayaton mein Khwlah ke bajaye Khawailah bhi aaya hai aur bint-e-Sa'labah ke badle bint-e-Malik bin Sa'labah bhi aaya hai, in aqwaal mein koi aisa ikhtilaf nahi jo ek dusre ke khilaf ho, Wallahu A'lam. Is surat ki in shuru ki aayaton ka sahi shan-e-nuzool yahi hai.

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair ؒ farmate hain Eela aur Zihar Jahiliyat ke zamane ki talaqein thin, Allah Ta'ala ne Eela mein toh char mahine ki muddat muqarrar farmayi aur Zihar mein kaffarah muqarrar farmaya. Hazrat Imam Malik ؒ ne lafz 'min kum' se istedlal kiya hai ki chunke yahan khitab momino se hai isliye is hukm mein kafir dakhil nahi, jumhoor ka mazhab is ke barkhilaf hai woh is ka jawab yeh dete hain ki yeh ba-aitibar-e-ghalbah ke keh diya gaya hai isliye ba-taur qaid ke is ka mafhoom-e-mukhalif murad nahi le sakte, lafz 'min nisa-ihim' se jumhoor ne istedlal kiya hai ki laundi se zihar nahi na woh is khitab mein dakhil hai. Phir farmata hai is kahne se ki tu mujh par meri maan ki tarah hai ya mere liye tu misl meri maan ke hai ya misl meri maan ki peeth ke hai ya aur aise hi alfaaz apni biwi ko keh dene se woh sach-much maan nahi ban jati, haqiqi maan toh wahi hai jis ke batn se yeh tawallud hua hai, yeh log apne munh se fahsh aur baatil qoul bol dete hain Allah Ta'ala darguzar karne wala aur bakhshish dene wala hai.

Usne jahiliyat ki is tangi ko tum se door kardiya, isi tarah har woh kalam jo ek dam zubeen se baghair soche samjhe aur bila qasad nikal jaye. Chunacha Abu Dawood waghera mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne suna ke ek shakhs apni biwi se keh raha hai ae meri behan to Aap ne farmaya yeh teri behan hai? Gharz yeh kehna bura laga use roka magar us se hurmat sabit nahi ki kyunke darasal is ka maqsood yeh na tha yoonhi zubeen se baghair qasad ke nikal gaya tha warna zaroor hurmat sabit hojati, kyunke sahih qaul yahi hai ke apni biwi ko jo shakhs is naam se yaad kare jo muharramat-e-abdiyyah hain maslan behan ya phuphi ya khala waghera to woh bhi hukm mein maan ke hain. Jo log zihar karein phir apne kehne se lotein is ka matlab ek to yeh bayan kiya gaya hai ke zihar kiya phir mukarrar is lafz ko kaha lekin yeh theek nahi, ba-qaul Hazrat Imam Shafai matlab yeh hai ke zihar kiya phir us aurat ko rok rakha yahan tak ke itna zamana guzar gaya ke agar chahta to us mein ba-qaida talaq de sakta tha lekin talaq na di. Imam Ahmad farmate hain ke phir lote jama' ki taraf ya irada kare to yeh halal nahi ta-waqtike mazkoora kaffara ada na kare. Imam Malik farmate hain ke murad is se jama' ka irada ya phir basane ka azm ya jama' hai. Imam Abu Hanifa waghera kehte hain murad zihar ki taraf lotna hai is ki hurmat aur jahiliyat ke hukm ke uth jane ke baad pas jo shakhs ab zihar karega us par is ki biwi haram hojayegi jab tak ke yeh kaffara ada na kare, Hazrat Saeed farmate hain murad yeh hai ke jis cheez ko us ne apni jaan par haram karliya tha ab phir us kaam ko karna chahe to is ka kaffara ada kare. Hazrat Hasan Basri ka qaul hai ke mujama'at karna chahe warna aur tarah chhone ke qabl kaffara ke bhi unke nazdeek koi haraj nahi. Ibn Abbas waghera farmate hain yahan mas se murad sohbat karna hai. Zuhri farmate hain ke haath lagana pyar karna bhi kaffara ki adayegi se pehle jaiz nahi. Sunan mein hai ke ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ maine apni biwi se zihar kiya tha phir kaffara ada karne se pehle main is se mil liya Aap ne farmaya Allah tujh par raham kare aisa tu ne kyun kiya? Kehne laga Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ chandni raat mein is ke khalkhal ki chamak ne mujhe betaab kardiya. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya ab is se qurbat na karna jab tak ke Allah ke farman ke mutabiq kaffara ada na karde, Nasai mein yeh hadith mursalan marwi hai aur Imam Nasai ؒ mursal hone ko awla batate hain. Phir kaffara bayan ho raha hai ke ek ghulam azad kare, haan yeh qaid nahi ke momin hi ho jaise qatl ke kaffare mein ghulam ke momin hone ki qaid hai.

Imam Shafi'i toh farmate hain yeh mutlaq is muqayyad par mahmool hogi kyunke ghulam ko azad karne ki shart jaisi wahan hai aisi hi yahan bhi hai, iski daleel yeh hadis bhi hai ke ek siyah fam laundi ki babat Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha use azad kardo yeh momina hai, upar waqia guzar chuka jis se maloom hota hai ke zihar karke phir kaffara se qabil waqie hone wale ko Aap ne doosra kaffara ada karne ko nahi farmaya. Phir farmata hai is se tumhe naseehat ki jati hai yani dhamkaya ja raha hai. Allah Ta'ala tumhari maslahaton se khabardar hai aur tumhare ahwal ka alim hai. Jo ghulam ko azad karne par qadir na ho woh do mahine ke lagataar roze rakhne ke baad apni biwi se is soorat mein mil sakta hai aur agar iska bhi maqdoor na ho toh phir sath miskeenon ko khana dene ke baad, pehle hadisein guzar chukin jin se maloom hota hai ke muqaddam pehli soorat phir doosri phir teesri, jaise ke Bukhari o Muslim ki is hadis mein bhi hai jisme Aap ne Ramazan mein apni biwi se jamaa karne wale ko farmaya tha. Hum ne yeh ahkaam is liye muqarrar kiye hain ke tumhara kamil iman Allah par aur uske Rasool ﷺ par ho jaye. Yeh Allah ki muqarrar karda hadein hain iske muharramat hain khabardar is hurmat ko na todna. Jo kafir hon yani iman na layen hukm bardari na karein shariat ke ahkaam ki bezati karein un se laparwahi bartein unhein balaon se bachne wala na samjho balki un ke liye duniya aur akhirat mein dardnak azab hain.

Ahkamat-e-Rasoolullah ﷺ aur hum farman hai ke Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ki mukhalifat karne wale aur ahkam-e-shara' se sartabi karne wale zillat, idbar, nahusat aur phatkar ke layiq hain jis tarah un se agle unhi a'mal ke ba'is barbad aur ruswa kar diye gaye, usi tarah wazih, is qadar zahir, itni saf aur aisi khuli hui aayatein bayan kar di hain aur nishaniyan zahir kar di hain ke siwaye us ke jis ke dil mein sarkashi ho koi in se inkar kar nahi sakta aur jo in ka inkar kare woh kafir hai aur aise kuffar ke liye yahan ki zillat ke baad wahan ke bhi ihanat wale azab hain, yahan un ke takabbur ne Allah ki taraf jhukne se roka wahan us ke badle unhein behadd zall kiya jayega, khoob ronda jayega, qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala tamam aglon pichlon ko ek hi maidan mein jama karega aur jo bhalai burai jis kisi ne ki thi us se use aagah karega. Go yeh bhool gaye the lekin Allah Ta'ala ne to use yaad rakha tha us ke farishton ne use likh rakha tha. Na to Allah par koi cheez chhup sake na Allah Ta'ala kisi cheez ko bhoole. Phir bayan farmata hai ki tum jahan ho jis halat mein ho na tumhari baatein Allah ke sunne se reh saken na tumhari halatein Allah ke dekhne se poshida raheen us ke ilm ne sari duniya ka ihata kar rakha hai use har zaban aur makan ki ittila har waqt hai, woh zamin aur aasman ki tamam tar kainat se ba-ilm hai, teen shakhs aapas mein mil kar nihayat poshidosgi, razdari ke sath apni baatein zahir karein unhein woh sunta hai aur woh apne aap ko teen hi na samjhein balki apna chouta Allah ko gine aur jo panch shakhs tanhai mein razdariyaan kar rahe hain woh chhata Allah ko jane phir jo us se kam hon ya us se zyada hon, woh bhi yaqeen rakhein ke woh jahan kahin bhi hain un ke sath un ka Allah hai ya'ni un ke hal-o-qal se muttala hai un ke kalam ko sun raha hai aur un ki halaton ko dekh raha hai phir sath hi sath us ke farishte bhi likhte ja rahe hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Alam ya'lamu annallaha ya'lamu sirrahum wa najwahum wa annallaha allamul-ghuyub) (At-Tawbah: 78) Kya log nahi jaante ke Allah Ta'ala un ki poshida baaton ko aur un ki sargoshiyon ko bakhubi janta hai aur Allah Ta'ala tamam ghaibon par ittila rakhne wala hai, aur jagah irshad hai ayat (Am yahsabuna anna la nasma'u sirrahum wa najwahum bala wa rusuluna ladaihim yaktubun) (Az-Zukhruf: 80) Kya un ka yeh guman hai ke hum un ki poshida baaton aur khufiya mashwaron ko sun nahi rahe? Barabar sun rahe hain aur hamare bheje hue un ke paas mojood hain jo likhte ja rahe hain, aksar buzrugon ne is baat par ijma' naql kiya hai ke is ayat se murad maiyyat-e-ilmi hai ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ka wajood nahi balki Allah Ta'ala ka ilm har jagah hai, har teen ke majma' mein choutha us ka ilm hai Tabaraka wa Ta'ala.

Beshak-o-shubha is baat par iman-e-kamil aur yaqin-e-rasikh rakhna chahiye ke yahan murad zat se sath hona nahi balki ilm se har jagah mojood hona hai, han beshak uska sunna dekhna bhi usi tarah uske ilm ke sath sath hai, Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala apni tamam makhlooq par muttla hai unka koi kaam usse poshida nahi, phir qayamat ke din unhe unke tamam amaal par tanbih karega, Allah Ta'ala har cheez ko janne wala hai. Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) farmate hain ke is aayat ko shuru bhi apne ilm ke bayan se kiya tha aur khatm bhi Allah ke ilm ke bayan par kiya (matlab yeh hai ke darmiyan mein Allah ka sath hona jo bayan kiya tha usse bhi az-roe-ilm ke sath hona hai na ke az-roe-zat ke. (Mutarjim))

Maasharati adaab ka ek pehlu aur Qayamat ka ek manzar. Kana phoonsi se yahudiyon ko rok diya gaya tha is liye ke un mein aur An-Hazrat ﷺ mein jab sulah safayi thi to yeh log yeh harkat karne lage ke jahan kisi Musalman ko dekha aur jahan koi un ke paas gaya yeh idhar udhar jama ho ho kar chupke chupke isharon kinayon mein is tarah kana phoonsi karne lagte ke akela dukela Musalman yeh guman karta ke shayad yeh log mere qatal ki sazishein kar rahe hain ya mere khilaf aur imandaron ke khilaf kuch makhfi tarkeebein soch rahe hain, use un ki taraf jaate hue bhi dar lagta, jab yeh shikayatein aam huin to Huzoor ﷺ ne yahudiyon ko is sufli harkat se rok diya, lekin unhon ne phir bhi yahi karna shuru kiya. 

Ibn Abi Hatim ki ek hadis mein hai ke hum log baari baari Rasoolullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein raat ko hazir hote ke agar koi kaam kaaj ho to karein, ek raat ko baari wale aagaye aur kuch aur log bhi ba-niyat-e-sawab aagaye chunke log zyada jama hogaye to hum toliyan toliyan ban kar idhar udhar baith gaye aur har jama'at aapas mein baatein karne lagi, itne mein An-Hazrat ﷺ tashreef laaye aur farmaya yeh sargoshiyan kya ho rahi hain? Kya tumhe is se roka nahi gaya? Hum ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ hamari tauba hum Masih Dajjal ka zikar kar rahe the kyunke is se khatka laga rehta hai, Aap ne farmaya suno main tumhe is se bhi zyada khauf ki cheez bataun woh poshida shirq hai is tarah ke ek shakhs uth khada ho aur doosron ke dikhane ke liye koi deeni kaam kare (yaani riyakari). Iski asnad ghareeb hai aur is mein ba'z rawi zaeef hain. 

Phir bayan hota hai ke un ki khanagi sargoshiyan ya to gunah ke kamon par hoti hain jis mein un ka zaati nuqsan hai, ya zulm par hoti hain jis mein doosron ke nuqsan ki tarkeebein sochte hain ya Paighambar (Alaihis Salam) ki mukhalifat par ek doosron ko pukhta karte hain aur Aap ki nafarmaniyon ke mansube ganthte hain. 

Phir in badkaron ki ek badtareen khaslat bayan ho rahi hai ke salam ke alfaaz ko bhi yeh badal dete hain, Hazrat Aishah Siddiqah (R.A) farmati hain ek martaba yahudi Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kaha Assaamu Alaika ya Abul Qasim. Hazrat Aishah se raha na gaya farmaya Wa Alaikaus Sam. Sam ke maani maut ke hain. An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya Aiy Aishah Allah Ta'ala bure alfaaz aur sakht kalamhi ko napasand farmata hai. Main ne kaha kya Huzoor ﷺ ne nahi suna? Unhon ne Aap ko Assalam nahi kaha balki Assaam kaha hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya kya tum ne nahi suna? Main ne keh diya Wa Alaikum. Isi ka bayan yahan ho raha hai. Doosri riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Aishah ne un ke jawab mein farmaya tha Alaikumus Sam wannamu wal la'nah, aur Aap ne Siddiqah ko rokte hue farmaya ke hamari dua un ke haq mein maqbool hai aur un ka hamein ko sunana maqbool hai (Ibn Abi Hatim waghera). 

Ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ apne ashab ke majma' mein tashreef farma the ke ek yahudi ne aakar salam kiya sahabah ne jawab diya phir Huzoor ﷺ ne sahabah se poocha maloom bhi hai is ne kya kaha tha? Unhon ne kaha Hazrat ﷺ salam kiya tha.

Aap ﷺ ne farmaya nahin us ne kaha tha Sam Alaikum yaani tumhara deen maghloub ho kar mit jaye, phir Aap ﷺ ne hukm diya ke us yahudi ko bulao jab woh aagaya to Aap ne farmaya sach sach bata kya tu ne Sam Alaikum nahin kaha tha ? Us ne kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ main ne yehi kaha tha Aap ne farmaya suno jab kabhi koi Ahl-e-Kitab tum mein se kisi ko salam kare to tum sirf Alaik keh diya karo yaani jo tu ne kaha ho woh tujh par (Ibn Jareer waghairah) phir yeh log apne is kartoot par khush ho kar apne dil mein kehte ke agar yeh Nabi-e-Barhaq hota to Allah Ta'ala hamari is chaal-bazi par humein duniya mein zaroor azaab karta is liye ke Allah Ta'ala to hamare batini haal se ba-khoobi waqif hai.

Pas Allah Ta'ala farmata hai unhein Daar-e-Akhirat ka azaab hi kafi hai jahan yeh Jahannam mein jayenge aur buri jagah pohnchenge. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A se marwi hai ke is ayat ka shan-e-nuzool yahudiyon ka is tareeqe ka salam hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se manqool hai ke munafiq isi tarah salam karte thay. 

Phir Allah Ta'ala momino ko adab sikhata hai ke tum in munafiqon aur yahudiyon ke se kaam na karna tum gunah ke kaamon aur had se guzar jane aur Nabi ke na manne ke mashware na karna balki tumhein inke barkhilaf neki aur apne bachao ke mashware karne chahiye. Tumhein har waqt us Allah se darte rehna chahiye jis ki taraf tumhein jama hona hai, jo us waqt tumhein har neki badi ki jaza saza dega aur tamam aamal-o-aqwal se mutanabbeh karega go tum bhool gaye lekin us ke paas sab mehfooz aur maujood hai. 

Hazrat Safwan farmate hain main Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ka haath thame huwa tha ke ek shakhs aaya aur poocha Aap ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se momin ki jo sargoshi qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala se hogi us ke bare mein kya suna hai ? Adab-e-Majalis, Baham Mamalat aur Ulama-e-Haq-o-Baamal ki Tauqir

Yahan Iman walon ko Allah Ta'ala majlisi adab sikhata hai. Unhein hukm deta hai ke nishat-o-barkhast mein bhi ek dusre ka khayal-o-lihaz rakho. Toh farmata hai ke jab majlis jama ho aur koi aaye toh zara idhar udhar hat-hatakar use bhi jagah do. Majlis mein kushadgi karo. Uske badle Allah Ta'ala tumhein kushadgi dega. Isliye ke har amal ka badla usi jaisa hota hai, chunacha ek hadis mein hai jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala ke liye masjid banade Allah Ta'ala uske liye jannat mein ghar bana dega. Ek aur hadis mein hai ke jo kisi sakhti wale par asani kare Allah Ta'ala us par duniya aur akhirat mein asani karega, jo shakhs apne kisi musalman bhai ki madad mein laga rahe Allah Ta'ala khud apne is bande ki madad par rehta hai aur bhi isi tarah ki bahut si hadishein hain.

Hazrat Qatadah ؒ farmate hain yeh ayat majlise zikr ke bare mein utri hai misal ke taur par waz ho raha hai Huzoor ﷺ kuch naseehat ki baatein bayan farma rahe hain log baithe sun rahe hain ab jo dusra koi aaya toh koi apni jagah se nahi sarakta taake use bhi jagah mil jaye. Quran-e-Kareem ne hukm diya ke aisa na karo idhar udhar khul jaya karo taake aane wale ki jagah hojaye.

Hazrat Muqatil farmate hain Jumma ke din yeh ayat utri, Rasool Allah ﷺ us din suffah mein the yaani masjid ke ek chappar tale jagah tang thi aur aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke jo Muhajir aur Ansar Badr ki ladaai mein aap ke sath the aap un ki badi izrat aur takrim kiya karte the us din ittefaq se chand Badri Sahaba der se aaye toh Anhuzoor ﷺ ke aas paas khade hogaye aap se salam alaik hui aap ne jawab diya phir aur ahl-e-majlis ko salam kiya unhon ne bhi jawab diya ab yeh isi ummid par khade rahe ke majlis mein zara kushadgi dekhein toh baith jayein lekin koi shakhs apni jagah se na hila jo un ke liye jagah hoti. Anhuzoor ﷺ ne jab yeh dekha toh raha na gaya naam le lekar baaz logon ko un ki jagah se khada kiya aur un Badri Sahabiyon ko baithne ko farmaya, jo log khade karaaye gaye the unhein zara bhaari pada idhar munafiqein ke hath mein ek mashghala lag gaya, kehne lage lijiye yeh adl karne ke mudai nabi hain ke jo log shuru se aaye pehle aaye apne nabi ke qareeb jagah li itminan se apni apni jagah baith gaye unhein toh un ki jagah se khada kar diya aur der se aane walon ko un ki jagah dilwa di kis qadar na-insafi hai, idhar Huzoor ﷺ ne isliye ke un ke dil maile na hon dua ki ke Allah us par raham kare jo apne musalman bhai ke liye majlis mein jagah karde. Is hadis ko sunte hi Sahaba ne foran khud-ba-khud apni jagah se hatna aur aane walon ko jagah dena shuru kar diya aur Jumma hi ke din yeh ayat utri (Ibnu Abi Hatim).

Bukhari, Muslim, Musnad waghera mein hadis hai ke koi shakhs kisi dusre shakhs ko us ki jagah se hatakar wahan na baithe balke tumhein chahiye ke idhar udhar sarak kar us ke liye jagah banado.

Shafi'i mein hai, tum mein se koi shakhsh apne bhai ko jum'ah ke din us ki jagah se hargaz na uthaye balki keh de ke gunjaish karo. Is masle mein ulama ka ikhtilaf hai ke kisi aane wale ke liye khade hojana jaiz hai ya nahi? Baaz log to ijazat dete hain aur yeh hadith pesh karte hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya apne sardar ke liye khade hojao, baaz ulama mana karte hain aur yeh hadith pesh karte hain ke jo shakhsh yeh chahe ke log us ke liye seedhe khade hon woh jahannam mein apni jagah bana le, baaz buzurg tafseel bayan karte hain aur farmate hain ke safar se agar koi aaya ho to hakim ke liye ohda-e-hukmarani ke sabab logon ka khade hojana durust hai kyunke Huzoor ﷺ ne jin ke liye khada hone ko farmaya tha yeh Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az ؓ the. Banu Quraiza ke aap hakim banaye gaye the jab unhe aata hua dekha to Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha ke apne sardar ke liye khade hojao aur yeh (batour-e-ta'zeem ke na tha balki) sirf is liye tha ke un ke ahkam ko bakhubi jari karaye wallahu a'lam. Haan ise aadat bana lena ke majlis mein jahan koi bada admi aaya aur log khade hogaye yeh ajmiyon ka tareeqa hai, sunan ki hadith mein hai ke Sahaba-e-Kiram ke nazdeek Rasoolullah ﷺ se zyada mahboob aur ba-izzat koi na tha lekin taham aap ko dekh kar woh khade nahi huwa karte the, jaante the ke aap ise makrouh samajhte hain. Sunan ki aur hadith mein hai ke Rasoolullah ﷺ aate hi majlis ke khatimah par baith jaya karte the aur jahan aap tashreef farma hojate wohi jagah sadarat ki jagah hojati aur Sahaba-e-Kiram apne apne maratib ke mutabiq majlis mein baith jaate. Hazrat As-Siddiq ؓ ke aap dayen janib, Farooq ؓ aap ke bayen aur umuman Hazrat Usman o Ali ؓ aap ke samne baithte kyunki yeh dono buzurg katib-e-wahi the aap un se farmate aur yeh wahi ko likh liya karte the. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ka farman tha ke mujh se qareeb ho kar aqalmand, sahib-e-farasat log baithein phir darja badarja aur yeh intizam is liye tha ke Huzoor ﷺ ke mubarak irshadaat yeh hazraat sunein aur bakhubi samjhein, yahi wajah thi ke suffah wali majlis mein jis ka zikr abhi ab

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ namaz ki safon ki durusti ke waqt hamare moondhe khud pakad pakad kar theek thak karte aur zubani bhi farmate jaate seedhe raho tedhe tirche na khade hua karo, danai aur aqlmandi wale mujh se bilkul qareeb rahein phir darja ba darja doosre log. Hazrat Abu Masood R.A is hadees ko bayaan farma kar farmate is hukm ke bawajood afsos ke ab tum badi tedhi safin karte ho, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Nasai aur Ibn Majah mein bhi yeh hadees hai zahir hai ke jab Aap ka yeh hukm namaz ke liye tha toh namaz ke sifa kisi aur waqton mein toh bi-taur-e-aula yahi hukm rahega, Abu Dawood Sharif mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya safon ko durust karo, moondhe milaye rakho, safon ke darmiyan khaali jagah na chhodo apne bhaiyon ke paas saf mein narm ban jaya karo, saf mein shaitan ke liye surakh na chhodo saf milane wale ko Allah Ta'ala milata hai aur saf todne wale ko Allah Ta'ala kaat deta hai, is liye Syed-ul-Qurra Hazrat Ubayy bin Kaab R.A jab pahonchte toh saf-e-awwal mein se kisi zaeef-ul-aql shakhs ko peeche hata dete aur khud pehli saf mein mil jaate aur isi hadees ko daleel mein late ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya hai mujh se qareeb zi-raye aur aala aqlmand khade hon phir darja ba darja doosre log. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ko dekh kar agar koi shakhs khada hojata toh Aap us ki jagah par na baithte aur is hadees ko pesh karte jo upar guzri ke kisi ko utha kar us ki jagah mein koi aur na baithe, yahan bi-taur-e-namoone ke yeh chand masail aur thodi hadeesein likh kar hum aage chalte hain bast-o-tafseel ki yahan gunjaish nahi na yeh mauqa hai, ek sahih hadees mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ baithe hue the ke teen shakhs aaye ek toh majlis ke darmiyan jagah khaali dekh kar wahan aakar baith gaye doosre ne majlis ke aakhir mein jagah bana li teesre wapas chale gaye, Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya logon main tumhe teen shakhsyon ki baabat khabar doon ek ne toh Allah ki taraf jagah li aur Allah Ta'ala ne use jagah di, doosre ne sharm ki, Allah ne bhi us se haya ki, teesre ne munh pher liya toh Allah Ta'ala ne bhi us se munh pher liya.

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke kisi ko halal nahi ke do shakhson ke darmiyan tafriq kare, haan unki khushnudi se ho to aur baat hai (Abu Dawood, Tirmizi). Imam Tirmizi ne ise hasan kaha hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Hazrat Hasan Basri waghera farmate hain majlison ki kushadagi ka hukm jihad ke bare mein hai, isi tarah uth khare hone ka hukm bhi jihad ke bare mein hai. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain yaani jab tumhein bhalayi aur kar-e-khair ki taraf bulaya jaye to tum foran aa jao. Hazrat Muqatal farmate hain, matlab yeh hai ke jab tumhein namaz ke liye bulaya jaye to uth khare ho jaya karo. Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid farmate hain ke Sahaba jab Huzoor ﷺ ke haan aate to jaate waqt har ek ki chahat yeh hoti ke sab se aakhir Huzoor ﷺ se juda main hoon, basa auqat Aap ko koi kaam-kaaj hota to bara harj hota lekin Aap maruwat se kuch na farmate, is par yeh hukm hua ke jab tumse khare hone ko kaha jaye to khare ho jaya karo, jaise aur jagah hai: "Wa in qila lakum irji'u farji'u" (agar tumse laut jaane ko kaha jaye to laut jao). Jo shakhs ahkaam-e-Ilahiha par tawazu se gardan jhuka de Allah Ta'ala uski izzat barhata hai aur uski shohrat neki ke sath karta hai. Imaan walon aur sahih ilm walon ka yahi kaam hota hai ke Allah ke ahkaam ke samne gardan jhuka diya karein aur is se woh buland darjon ke mustahiq ho jate hain. Allah Ta'ala ko bakhubi ilm hai ke buland martabon ka mustahiq kaun hai aur kaun nahi?

Hazrat Nafi bin Abdul Harith se Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ki mulaqat Usfan mein hui hai. Hazrat Umar ne unhein Makkah Sharif ka aamil banaya tha to unse pucha ke tum Makkah Sharif mein apni jagah kise chhor aaye ho? Jawab diya ke Ibn Abza ko. Hazrat Umar Farooq ne farmaya woh to hamare maula hain (yaani aazad karda ghulam), unhein tum Ahl-e-Makkah ka ameer bana kar chale aaye ho? Kaha haan is liye ke woh Allah ki kitab ka mahir aur faraiz ka janne wala aur achha waaz kehne wala hai. Hazrat Umar ne us waqt farmaya: Sach farmaya Rasool Allah ﷺ ne ke Allah Ta'ala is kitab ki waja se ek kaum ko izzat par pucha kar buland martaba karega aur baaz ko past aur kam martaba bana dega (Muslim).

Ilm aur ulama ki fazilat, jo is aayat aur deegar aayaat o ahadith se zahir hai, main ne un sab ko Bukhari Sharif ki Kitab-ul-Ilm ki sharh mein jama kar diya hai, walhamdulillah.

Nabi Kareem ﷺ se sargoshi ki mansookh shart Allah Ta'ala apne momin bando ko hukum deta hai ke mere Nabi se jab tum koi raaz ki baat karna chaho toh us se pehle meri rah mein khairat karo taake tum paak saaf ho jao aur is qabil ban jao ke mere paighambar se mashwara kar sako, haan agar koi ghareeb maskeen shakhs ho toh khair. Uske Allah Ta'ala ki bakhshsh aur uske raham par nazrein rakhni chahiyen yani yeh hukum sirf unhein hai jo maaldar hon. Phir toh yeh hukum hi hat gaya. Phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn Jareer mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Ali se poocha kya sadqa ki miqdaar ek dinar muqarrar karni chahiye toh aap ﷺ ne farmaya yeh toh bohat hui. Qiyamat wale din jab unka hashr hoga aur ek bhi is maidan mein aaye baghair na rahega, sab jama ho jayenge to chunke zindagi mein unki aadat thi ke apni jhoot baat ko qasmon se sach baat kar dikhate the, aaj Allah ke samne bhi apni hidayat-o-istiqamat par badi badi qasmein kha lenge aur samajhte honge ke yahan bhi yeh chalaki chal jayegi, magar in jhoton ki bhala Allah ke samne chal bazi kahan chal sakti hai? Yeh yahan se chala gaya aur jin jin ka naam Huzoor ﷺ ne liya tha unhein lekar aaya aur phir to qasmon ka tanta bandh diya ke hum mein se kisi ne Huzoor ﷺ ki koi be-adabi nahi ki. Yeh likhne wala Allah qawi hai aur uska likha hua atal hai, woh ghalib-o-qahhar hai, apne dushmano par har waqt qaboo rakhne wala hai. Uska yeh atal faisla aur tay shuda amr hai ki dono jahan mein anjam ke aitbar se ghalba-o-nasrat mominon ka hissa hai. 

Phir farmata hai ki yeh namumkin hai ki Allah ke dost Allah ke dushmano se mohabbat rakhein. Ek aur jagah hai ki musalmanon ko chahiye ki musalmanon ko chhod kar kafiron ko apna wali dost na banayein, aisa karne wale Allah ke haan kisi ginti mein nahi, haan dar-khouf ke waqt arzi dafa ke liye ho to aur baat hai. Allah Ta'ala tumhe apni girami zat se dara raha hai aur jagah hai: Ae Nabi ﷺ aap ailan kar dijiye ki agar tumhare baap, dada, bete, pote, bacche, kunba, qabila, maal-o-daulat, tijarat-o-hirfat, ghar-baar waghera tumhe Allah Ta'ala se, uske Rasul ﷺ se, uski raah mein jihad ki nisbat zyada azeez aur mehboob hain toh tum Allah ke anqareeb baras padne wale azab ka intizar karo. Is qisam ke fasiqon ki rahbari bhi Allah ki taraf se nahi hoti. 

Hazrat Saeed bin Abdul Aziz ؒ farmate hain yeh ayat Hazrat Abu Ubaidah Amir bin Abdullah bin Jarrah ؓ ke bare mein utri hai, jang-e-badar mein unke walid kufr ki himayat mein musalmanon ke muqable par aaye, aap ne unhe qatl kar diya tha.

Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne apne akhri waqt mein jabke khilafat ke liye ek jama'at ko muqarrar kiya ke yeh log mil kar jise chahhein khalifa bana lein, us waqt Hazrat Abu Ubaidah ki nisbat farmaya tha ke agar yeh hote toh main unhi ko khalifa muqarrar karta. Aur yeh bhi farmaya gaya hai ke ek ek sifat alag alag buzurgon mein thi, masalan Hazrat Abu Ubaidah bin Jarrah ne toh apne walid ko qatal kiya tha aur Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (R.A) ne apne bete Abdur Rahman ke qatal ka irada kiya tha aur Hazrat Mus'ab bin Umair (R.A) ne apne bhai Ubaid bin Umair ko qatal kiya tha aur Hazrat Umar aur Hazrat Hamza aur Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Ubaidah bin Haris ne apne qaribi rishtedaaron Utbah, Shaibah aur Waleed bin Utbah ko qatal kiya tha, Wallahu A'lam.

Isi ziman mein yeh waqiya bhi dakhil ho sakta hai ke jis waqt Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne Badri qaیدیon ki nisbat Musalmanon se mashwara kiya toh Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (R.A) ne toh farmaya ke un se fidiya le liya jaye taake Musalmanon ki mali mushkilat door ho jayein, mushrikon se jihad karne ke liye alat-e-harb jama kar lein aur yeh chhod diye jayein, kya ajab ke Allah Ta'ala un ke dil Islam ki taraf pher de, akhir hain toh hamare hi kunbe rishte ke. Lekin Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne apni rai is ke bilkul barkhilaf pesh ki ke Ya Rasoolullah (ﷺ) jis Musalman ka jo rishtedaar mushrik hai, us ke hawalay kar diya jaye aur use hukum diya jaye ke woh use qatal kar de, hum Allah Ta'ala ko dikhana chahte hain ke hamare dilon mein in mushrikon ki koi mohabbat nahi, mujhe falan rishtedaar saunp dijiye aur Hazrat Ali ke hawalay Aqeel kar dijiye aur falan Sahabi ko falan kafir de dijiye waghera.

Phir farmata hai ke jo apne dil ko dushmanan-e-Allah ki mohabbat se khali kar de aur mushrik rishtedaaron se bhi mohabbat chhod de, woh kamil-ul-iman shakhs hai jis ke dil ne iman mein jadhein jamali hain aur jin ki qismat mein saadat likhi ja chuki hai aur jin ki nigah mein iman ki zeenat bas gayi hai aur un ki ta'aid Allah Ta'ala ne apne paas ki rooh se ki hai yani unhein qawi bana diya hai aur yahi behti hui nahron wali jannat mein jayenge jahan se kabi na nikale jayenge. Allah Ta'ala un se raazi, yeh Allah se khush, chunke unhon ne Allah ke khatir kunbe walon ko naraz kar diya tha, Allah Ta'ala is ke badle un se raazi ho gaya aur unhein is qadr diya ke yeh bhi khush khush ho gaye.

Allah ka lashkar yehi hai aur kamyab groh bhi yehi hai, jo shaitani lashkar aur nakam groh ke muqabil hai, Hazrat Abu Hazim A'raj ne Hazrat Zuhri ؒ ko likha ke jah do qism ki hai ek woh jise Allah Ta'ala apne auliya ke hathon par jari karta hai, jo hazrat aam logon ki nigahon mein nahi jachte jin ki aam shohrat nahi hoti jin ki sifat Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne bhi bayan farmai hai, ke Allah Ta'ala un logon ko dost rakhta hai jo gumnam muttaqi neko kar hain agar woh na ayin to pooch gach na ho aur ajayin to ao bhagat na ho un ke dil hidayat ke chiragh hain, har siyah rang andhere wale fitne se nikalte hain ye hain woh auliya jinhe Allah ne apna lashkar farmaya hai aur jin ki kamyabi ka elan kiya hai. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Naeem bin Hammad mein hai ke Rasool اللہ ﷺ ne apni dua mein farmaya aye Allah kisi fasiq fajir ka koi ehsan aur sulook mujh par na rakh kyunke main ne teri nazil karda wahi mein پڑھا hai ke imandar Allah ke mukhalifin ke dost nahi hote, Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain ulama-e-salaf ka khayal hai ke yeh ayat un logon ke bare mein utri hai jo badshah se khalat malat rakhte hon (Abu Ahmad Askari) Alhamdulillah Surah Mujadalah ki tafsir khatam hui.)
